ideas.title: Investigating the Impact of Trump's Child Care Funding Freeze
ideas.description: This story would investigate the effects of President Trump's child care funding freeze on programs nationwide.
questions: How many child care programs will be affected by the funding freeze?
What are the potential consequences for families relying on these programs?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal a significant impact on vulnerable families and highlight the need for transparency in federal funding decisions.
